对大多数带货与知识类主播，业内成熟打法是\"公域获客 + 人设背书 + 私域沉淀: For most live-commerce and knowledge streamers, the industry's proven playbook is public traffic + a credible persona + private domain retention. Douyin brings followers, orders and breakout hits; RED builds an aesthetic persona, high AOV and search mindshare; WeChat Channels plus WeCom handle repeat purchases and long-term client care. The three traffic logics complement each other rather than substitute for one another. When resources are tight, go deep on one first and add a second later.
本报告面向\"在抖音、虎牙、微信视频号、小红书四个备选平台中做出直播选型\"这一: This report answers one decision: which of Douyin, Huya, WeChat Channels and RED to stream on. Built on public data from 2025 to early 2026, it compares the four across platform fundamentals, audience profile, user spending power and platform policy — and ranks fit across all four for each of 35 livestream formats in 8 categories.

WeChat Channels prohibits digital-avatar streaming entirely — using a virtual identity gets the account banned. From 2026-08 RED requires an AI disclosure, throttling anything unlabeled; 420,000 AI-managed accounts have already been actioned. Leaving a pre-recorded replay running is a bannable offence on every platform.

Huya cracks down hard on gambling and vulgar content. Channels sits on WeChat's real-name system, so a violation spills over onto your personal WeChat — the most expensive ban of the four. RED is toughest on off-platform diversion: under its Transaction and Traffic Diversion Rules, three violations permanently close buyer privileges.
